title: Collect independent factorial results
description: You follow task submission and input-keyed result collection without comparing performance.

steps.description: You define factorial as a product fold starting from one. sum_of_factorials maps that helper over its inputs and sums the results.
You submit one factorial task per number. The futures dictionary maps each submitted task back to its input.

steps.question: How does the collector identify the input for a task returned by as_completed?
steps.answer: It looks up futures[future] and stores future.result() under that input key. Completion order therefore does not determine the keys.

steps.description: You run the supplied worker configurations and then print input-sorted factorial results. The recorded sum of factorials is 1308157003560.
